data.standardized_narrative: Opening gross claims outstanding at 1 January 2016 is shown in the technical reserves / claims movement note. No explicit gross prior-year movement figure or clear sentence quantifying a gross prior-year reserve release or strengthening could be located in the scanned pages provided.
data.data_quality_notes: Document supplied as scanned images with low legibility in many tables. I was able to locate the technical provisions / claims outstanding table showing a 'Balance at 1 January' value of GBP 350,170,000 (interpreted as 350.17m) at page 33 and used that as opening gross claims outstanding. However, I could not confidently find an explicit gross prior-year movement (movement in prior year's provision for claims outstanding) in the readable text or notes. Many numeric tables (claims development triangle, movement reconciliations, premium segmental analysis) are present but not reliably legible to extract precise gross amounts or the required movement-line. Therefore prior-year development, premium totals and segmental premium mix are left null/empty. If you can provide higher-resolution images or the original PDF text layer I can extract the missing items precisely.
